identity.subject: Procedural translucent jellyfish, evocative rather than species-specific
features: Open umbrella bell with scalloped margin and radial furrows
Four internal rose-colored gonad loops visible through a pale cyan bell
Twenty-four fine marginal tentacles anchored to the moving rim
Four broad folded oral arms attached beneath the central disc

structure.scale: Bell diameter 2.36 scene units; longest tentacle 3.0 units
structure.anchors: Rim, radial canals, and tentacle roots recomputed from the same analytic bell surface
structure.deformation: Bell contraction changes radial and vertical profile; travelling tentacle wave is phase-lagged by normalized arc length

shots.camera: One velocity-continuous eased dolly from z=8.6 to z=7.6 with a restrained lateral move
shots.action: Two bell contraction cycles, continuous phase-lagged tentacles and oral arms; no cuts
shots.composition: Hero right of center, full appendages in frame; copy in upper left

motion.tentacleWave: sin(3.40*t - 5.8*s + index*0.77), amplitude vanishes at anchor

datasetReferences.use: Inspected custom radial bell surface, scalloped margin, tube details and hierarchy. Reauthored all geometry and deterministic deformation; did not run upstream page.

assetProvenance.source: Independent agent forward-test of UnrealMotion; HF scene-000006 studied as reference

limitations: A polished procedural study, not a species-anatomy or photoreal animal claim.
Translucency uses layered raster materials, without volumetric subsurface scattering.
